standardDisclaimer.heading: Standard Mutual Fund Disclaimer — Mandatory per SEBI / AMFI
standardDisclaimer.body: Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks. Please read all scheme-related documents carefully before investing. Past performance is not indicative of future results. The NAV of schemes may go up or down depending on market factors. There is no guarantee or assurance of returns. Investors are advised to consult their financial / tax advisors before making any investment decision.

sections.title: 1. Nature of Our Business
sections.intro: Innovate Securities Private Limited is a SEBI-registered Stock Broker (NSE & BSE), a CDSL Depository Participant, and an AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN-42505) providing the following services:
bullets: Facilitating purchase, redemption, switch, and SIP registration of Mutual Fund units on behalf of investors
Stock broking services as a corporate member of NSE and BSE
Depository participant services with CDSL
Distribution / facilitation of Government & Corporate Bonds, Fixed Deposits (FDs), and Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs)
Providing investor education content, financial tools, and general financial information

notDo.heading: What Innovate Securities does NOT do:
items: We do NOT provide personalised investment advice
We are NOT a SEBI RIA
We do NOT provide tax, legal, or accounting advice
We do NOT facilitate Direct Plan Mutual Fund investments

subsections.heading: Mutual Funds
bullets: Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks — NAV may rise or fall based on market conditions.
Past performance does not guarantee future returns — do not invest based on past performance alone.
There is no assurance that the investment objective of any scheme will be achieved.
Innovate Securities deals in Regular Plans only — trail commission is earned from AMCs as part of TER, which is not an additional charge to investors.
Direct Plans are available at lower expense ratios through AMC portals — Innovate Securities does not facilitate Direct Plan investments.
Please read the Scheme Information Document (SID), Statement of Additional Information (SAI), and Key Information Memorandum (KIM) carefully before investing.

subsections.heading: Securities Market & Depository
subsections.callout: Trading in securities is subject to market risks. Innovate Securities Pvt. Ltd. is registered with SEBI as a Stock Broker (Registration No. INZ000224735) and as a Depository Participant with CDSL (Registration No. IN-DP-CDSL-594-2021). Please read all relevant disclosures and risk documents carefully before investing or trading.

sections.title: 3. Website Content Disclaimer
bullets: The content on www.innovatesec.com is for general information and educational purposes only — it does not constitute investment advice.
Information on this website is updated periodically but may not always reflect the most current market conditions or regulatory changes.
Innovate Securities does not warrant the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of any information on this website.
Any views, opinions, or market commentary on this website are the general views of Innovate Securities and should not be construed as personalised advice.
Third-party links on this website are provided for convenience only — Innovate Securities is not responsible for third-party content.

callout.heading: Calculator Disclaimer
callout.body: All financial calculators on this website provide illustrative projections only. Results are based on assumptions provided by users and do not account for taxes, inflation, fund manager performance, or other variables. Calculator outputs do NOT constitute investment advice or a guarantee of returns.

sections.title: 4. Commission & Remuneration Disclosure
bullets: Innovate Securities receives trailing commission from AMCs on Regular Plan Mutual Fund investments — this is part of the scheme’s TER and is not an additional charge to investors.
Exact commission details will be published on our Commission Disclosure page under MF Compliance.
Commission earned on your investments is visible in your Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) from CAMS, KFintech, or MF Central.
All product recommendations are based on investor suitability — never on commission rates received.
Innovate Securities does not receive any non-cash benefits, gifts, or incentives from AMCs that could create a conflict of interest.

sections.title: 8. Data Privacy
sections.body: All personal data collected by Innovate Securities is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy (available at www.innovatesec.com/privacy-policy) and applicable data protection laws including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties except as required for service delivery or by law.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
bullets: Innovate Securities shall not be liable for any investment losses arising from market fluctuations or scheme performance.
Innovate Securities shall not be liable for decisions made by investors based on general information or educational content on this website.
Our liability is limited to the specific service transaction in question, as permitted by applicable law.
This website and its content are provided "as is" without any warranty of any kind.
